what: Identifiers carrying a Portuguese word, per file, split by what kind of name it is: `decl` (variables, functions, classes, interfaces, type aliases, enums), `param` (parameters and destructured bindings) and `membro` (properties, methods, accessors and enum members). The gate refuses any increase IN ANY of the three, so a renamed parameter cannot hide a new Portuguese declaration. Run --bootstrap to record a decrease. 📌 `membro` is the debt phase 7 of the English plan renames (ADR-0219); measuring it is this file, renaming it is a breaking release.
